dct_description_sm:
This repository contains code and data for study titled 'Added value of a priori bias correcting dynamically downscaled data for application to species distribution models - a case study for coastal British Columbia'. It contains the following folders -
1. Data generated and used to produce the plots in the paper.
2. Python notebooks used to prepare the plots.
